annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública (Secretaria de Acesso à Justiça), CONDEGE, DPU
key_provisions_or_claims: Unified AI strategy across state, Federal District and Union Public Defender offices
Transparency, including algorithmic transparency, as guiding principle
Human rights at core; address algorithmic racism and bias
Human supervision, security and reliability monitoring of models; training of defenders
Unified training-data repository with data protection and data sovereignty; governance via committee/executive committee
annotation.summary_en: Public consultation (Dec 2023–Jun 2024) by Brazil's Ministry of Justice, CONDEGE and DPU on a unified strategy for deploying generative AI in Public Defender offices. It poses 15 questions on risks, human rights, algorithmic bias, data protection, transparency, human oversight, model choice, training and governance.
annotation.title_clean: Estratégia de Implantação da Inteligência Artificial pelas Defensorias Públicas do Brasil
annotation.title_en: Strategy for Implementing Artificial Intelligence in Brazil's Public Defender Offices
